title: Kompetansemeglere for forskningsmobilisering i Troms
description: Bakgrunn Troms fylkeskommune, ved FORREGION Troms i seksjon utvikling og innovasjon, har behov for ekstern bistand til forskningsmobilisering i næringslivet. Formålet er å styrke koblingen mellom bedrifter og relevante forsknings- og utviklingsmiljøer, og bidra til at flere virksomheter i Troms igangsetter forsknings- og innovasjonsprosjekter. FORREGION står for forskningsbasert innovasjon i regionene og er en tilskuddsordning rettet mot bedrifter med liten eller ingen erfaring med forskning og utviklingsarbeid. Anskaffelsen skal understøtte ordningens mål om å øke andelen FoU i næringslivet gjennom mobilisering, tettere kobling mellom næringsliv og FoU-miljøer og at forprosjekter i større grad leder videre til hovedprosjekter og annen videreført forskningsaktivitet. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres fordi fylkeskommunen har behov for kapasitet og spisskompetanse til å arbeide systematisk, oppsøkende og behovsstyrt overfor bedrifter, særlig små og mellomstore virksomheter som i liten grad har erfaring med forskning og utvikling. Det er samtidig et behov for å gjøre relevante FoU-miljøer, finansieringsordninger og øvrige virkemidler mer tilgjengelige for næringslivet i regionen. Oppdraget skal støtte målsettingen om økt forskningsinnsats i næringslivet, flere kvalifiserte søknader til relevante forskningsmidler og bedre regional dekning i mobiliseringsarbeidet. Det er særlig viktig å mobilisere forskningsumodne bedrifter i prioriterte bransjer, legge til rette for flere varige samarbeidsrelasjoner mellom næringsliv og FoU-aktører og bidra til videreføring av lovende initiativer fra tidlig idéfase og forprosjekt til større utviklings- og forskningsprosjekter. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdragsgiver skal anskaffe bistand fra totalt fem kompetansemeglerteam til forskningsmobilisering i Troms. Ressursene skal samlet dekke temaområdene sjømat, romvirksomhet/space, KI og teknologiutvikling samt Sirkulære Troms, hvor to av delkontraktene skal være knyttet til sjømat. Hver delkontrakt skal ivaretas av et kompetansemeglerteam med relevant og komplementær kompetanse innen aktuelt innsatsområde. Målgruppen for oppdraget er små og mellomstore bedrifter som tilhører Troms fylke, eller som har betydelig aktivitet i Troms. Kompetansemegling skal være et gratis tilbud til målgruppen. Oppdraget forutsetter at kompetansemeglerne opptrer uavhengig og nøytralt, og at de ikke representerer næringsaktører som kan stå i et konkurranseforhold til bedriftene som mottar bistand. Kompetansemeglere skal signere taushetserklæring. Leveransen omfatter oppsøkende kontakt med bedrifter, behovsanalyse, kartlegging av relevante FoU-partnere, kobling mellom bedrifter og forskningsmiljøer samt veiledning i utvikling av FoU-prosjekter og søknader om forskningsmidler. Oppfølgingen skal tilpasses den enkelte bedrifts behov og modenhet, og kan omfatte bistand fra tidlig idéavklaring og forprosjekt til videre mobilisering mot hovedprosjekter og andre relevante ordninger. Kompetansemegler skal være rådgiver og veileder i søknadsprosesser, men skal ikke skrive søknader på vegne av bedriftene eller opptre i konkurranse med private aktører. Kompetansemeglerteamene skal kunne identifisere virksomheters behov for forskning og innovasjon, bidra til å finne relevant forskningskompetanse og veilede bedriftene mot hensiktsmessige finansieringskilder. Dette inkluderer FORREGION og andre aktuelle ordninger, eksempelvis SkatteFUNN, Norges forskningsråd, Innovasjon Norge, Horisont Europa og andre relevante virkemidler. Der det er naturlig, skal kompetansemeglerne også henvise videre til andre aktører i virkemiddelapparatet. Oppdraget omfatter videre oppfølging av bedrifter som tidligere har gjennomført forprosjekter finansiert av FORREGION Troms, med mål om å bidra til videre utvikling og gjennomføring av hovedprosjekter. Kompetansemeglerne skal også kunne arrangere nettverksmøter mellom næringsliv og FoU-aktører for å identifisere felles problemstillinger, muligheter for forskning og utvikling samt styrke kunnskapsdeling og samarbeid. Det etterspørres ressurser med relevant erfaring fra forskningsmobilisering i næringslivet, god forståelse for regionale innovasjons- og FoU-miljøer, kjennskap til aktuelt næringsliv i regionen og evne til å arbeide behovsstyrt. Rollen krever gode samarbeidsevner, god kommunikasjonsforståelse og evne til å bygge tillit hos både bedrifter og forskningsmiljøer. Kompetansemeglerne skal videre samarbeide med øvrige kompetansemeglere i FORREGION, øvrige innovasjonsaktører i Troms og delta på relevante regionale og nasjonale samlinger, herunder obligatoriske opplærings- og samlingsaktiviteter i regi av Forskningsrådet. Oppdraget innebærer også rapportering til oppdragsgiver gjennom fastsatte digitale rapporteringsløsninger og maler. Rapporteringen skal blant annet gi oversikt over gjennomførte meglinger, ressursbruk, kontakt med FoU-institusjoner, prosjekter som er meglet videre til relevante ordninger, forprosjekter, nettverksmøter og øvrige relevante resultater og aktiviteter.

title: Oppgradering av uteområdet ved Åmli ungdomsskule
description: Bakgrunn Åmli kommune har behov for å oppgradere uteområdet ved Åmli ungdomsskule for å gi elever og ansatte et mer funksjonelt, sikkert og variert uteanlegg. Skolegården skal i større grad legge til rette for daglig skolebruk, aktivitet i friminutt, undervisning ute og samlingsarenaer for elever og ansatte. Uteområdet skal også kunne brukes av nærmiljøet til egenorganisert aktivitet. Oppgraderingen skal bidra til flere aktivitetsflater og bedre terrengtilpasning i skolegården. Det er særlig behov for nytt amfi i betong med oppholdsareal, sandvolleyballbane, oppmerking av basketballbane samt murer og terrengtiltak som sikrer god funksjon og tilpasning til eksisterende nivåforskjeller. Stærk & Co har utarbeidet forprosjekt og et omfattende prosjektert grunnlag for utomhusområdene på oppdrag fra Åmli kommune. Det foreligger utomhusplan, detaljtegninger, funksjonsbeskrivelse og IFC-modell som danner grunnlaget for anskaffelsen. Totalentreprenøren skal ivareta nødvendig videre detaljprosjektering, dimensjonering og koordinering for gjennomføringen. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder oppgradering av uteområdet ved Åmli ungdomsskule basert på utarbeidet prosjekteringsgrunnlag. Arbeidene omfatter etablering av amfi, murer og terrengtiltak, sandvolleyballbane, oppgradering av basketballbane med ny oppmerking og kurv, samt øvrige tiltak som fremgår av konkurransegrunnlaget og tilhørende vedlegg. Entreprenøren skal levere en komplett ytelse, inkludert nødvendige rigg- og driftsytelser, sikring av byggeplass, opprydding, dokumentasjon, FDV-dokumentasjon og som bygget-underlag. Arbeidene skal planlegges og gjennomføres slik at sikkerhet for elever, ansatte og øvrige brukere ivaretas i anleggsperioden. Gjennomføringen skal skje med særlig hensyn til skole i drift. Det innebærer blant annet behov for tydelig byggegjerde, adskilte soner og sikker adkomst for elever og ansatte. Nærmere krav til leveransen fremgår av konkurransegrunnlaget med vedlegg. Konkurransen gjennomføres elektronisk i HYYR. Konkurranseinformasjon, kvalifikasjonskrav, kravspesifikasjon, tildelingskriterier og øvrige opplysninger som fremgår av HYYR, inngår som en del av konkurransegrunnlaget. Det prosjektspesifikke konkurranse og kontraktsgrunnlaget er utarbeidet av Stærk & Co og består av Del 1 – Konkurransebeskrivelse og Del 2 Kontraktsgrunnlaget med vedlegg. Opplysningene i HYYR og de vedlagte konkurransedokumentene skal ses i sammenheng og utfyller hverandre.

Ook zijn veranderende wensen de aanleiding om aan te besteden. Doel van de Opdracht Aanbestedende Dienst wil tot één meerjarige Overeenkomst komen voor het leveren van Schoonmaakmiddelen en -disposables op basis van de in de aanbesteding gestelde eisen en wensen.

title: Germany – Construction work for bridges – Sanierung EÜ Strelasundbrücke, Korrosionsschutz 2027, Str. 6321, km 228,405
description: Die Strelasundbrücke ist eine Stahlbrücke im Zuge der DB Strecke 6321 von Stralsund nach Saßnitz. Sie überspannt im Streckenabschnitt Stralsund Rügendamm – Altefähr am Bahnkilometer 228,405 den Strelasund. Parallel zur EÜ verläuft die Straßenüberführung der L296. Beide Brücken sind auf denselben Brückenpfeilern gegründet. Die ursprüngliche Strelasundbrücke wurde 1936 in Betrieb genommen. 1989 erfolgte eine Generalinstandsetzung mit Einbau der jetzigen Überbauten. Die gesamte Brücke ist 540 m lang und ist in 10 Felder a 54 m gegliedert. Es ist eine eine umfängliche Vollerneuerung des Korrosionsschutzes geplant. Der straßenseitige Dienstweg sowie der Kabelkanal unter den Dienstwegabdeckplatten wurde bereits in 2026 umgebaut und korrosionsgeschützt. In der geplanten Baumaßnahme von 2027 bis 2023 soll der Hauptteil der EÜ eine neue Beschichtung erhalten, einschließlich der ablastenden H-Träger und der Konsolen der Oberleitung. Damit verfügt das Bauwerk dann ab 2031 in Gänze über einen neuen Korrosionsschutz. Um die Auswirkungen der erforderlichen Streckensperrung möglichst gering zu halten erfolgt die Ausführung der Arbeiten abschnittsweise und erstreckt sich insgesamt über einen Zeitraum von fünf Jahren. In den Jahren 2027 bis 2031 wird der Zugverkehr für jeweils sechs Wochen eingestellt. In diesem Zeitraum werden jeweils zwei Felder a 50 m korrosionsgeschützt. Diese Ausschreibung enthält nur die Arbeiten in 2027. Arbeiten im Gleisbereich werden in der Sperrpause vom 02.04.2027 bis 14.05.2027 und vom 15.10.2027 bis 29.10.2027 ausgeführt. Zusätzlich werden vor und nach den Sperrpausen Korrosionsschutz- und Gerüstbauarbeiten außerhalb des Gleisbereichs durchgeführt.

title: Denmark – Pipeline, piping, pipes, casing, tubing and related items – Supplier qualification system for Valve Supply Contracts concerning the Danish Hydrogen Backbone - 26/23313
description: The Danish Hydrogen Backbone (DHB) project is a comprehensive effort to establish a hydrogen infra-structure in Denmark, connecting planned large-scale hydrogen production in Denmark, produced from renewable energy sources such as wind and solar, with the German and European hydrogen markets. The project is part of the European hydrogen infrastructure and significantly contributes to the EU's goals of climate neutrality and reduction of greenhouse gas emissions. The full backbone is planned to extend all the way from underground storage in the northern part of Denmark (Lille Torup) to the German border (Frøslev), but a political decision has been made to initially focus on building the southern part of the system (Danish Hydrogen Pipeline – Phase 1), and thereby having this part operational by the end of 2030. The purpose of the SQS is to establish a pool of qualified Suppliers that may be invited to participate in procurements for the supply of valves required for the DHB. The SQS covers two valve qualification categories: Mainline & Large Station Ball Valves, including mainline, pipeline, large station, manual piping and process ball valves in manual and actuated configurations; and Control Valves, including General Control Valves and Critical / Severe-Service Control Valves.. Applicants may apply for one or both categories. Final quantities, sizes, pressure classes, duties and technical requirements will be specified in the individual tender documents.

title: Germany – Ships and boats – Marine-Hafenschlepper und flexibler Fähigkeitsträger (Navy-Tug flex) - TNW
description: Für die Deutsche Marine sind über eine Rahmenvereinbarung bis zu 20 baugleiche Hafenschlepper mit Arbeitsdeck der Klasse 724, die den Vorgaben einer anerkannten Klassifikationsgesellschaft und der deutschen Flagge entsprechen, aus einer bereits laufenden Serienproduktion neu zu beschaffen. Dabei ist über den Einsatz als reinen Schlepper hinaus eine zusätzliche Verwendung als "flexibler Fähigkeitsträger" beabsichtigt, welcher die Aufnahme von zwei ISO 20-Fuß-Standardcontainern bzw. vier ISO 10-Fuß-Containern und eine technische Seeausdauer von mindestens sieben Tagen ermöglicht. Aufgrund der aktuellen sicherheitspolitischen Lage ist zum Zwecke der Eindämmung des laufenden hybriden Krieges Russlands gegen die Bundesrepublik Deutschland und ihre Verbündeten im Nord- und Ostseeraum eine kurzfristige Beschaffung (bis 2028) erforderlich. Ziel ist es, die bei der Deutschen Marine derzeit vorhandenen sechs ca. 35 Jahre alten, nicht mehr bedarfsdeckenden Hafenschlepper der Klasse 725 zu ersetzen. Die vorgenannten Hafenschlepper werden insbesondere für die Erfüllung nachfolgender Einsatzaufgaben beschafft: • Assistenz/Bugsieren/Manövrieren von Schiffen und Booten der Marine auf Reeden und im Hafen, • Schleppen von Marineschiffen, -booten und Geräten im Hafen und im küstennahen Seegebiet, • Begleiten von Seezielschießen inkl. Transport, Ausbringen und Schleppen von Seezielen, • Aufnahme von zwei ISO 20-Fuß- Standardcontainern bzw. vier ISO 10-Fuß-Containern, • Unterstützung bei Werfterprobungen, Standproben und Kompensationsfahrten, • Eisdienst in den Häfen, • Brandbekämpfung im Hafen und auf See, • Hilfeleistung bei Gewässerverunreinigung sowie • Sicherung und Bergung von Schiffen und Booten in See.

title: Germany – Contractor's all-risk insurance services – Projektversicherung DSD Starterpaket Scan-Med- München
description: Der gegenständliche Realisierungsabschnitt gehört zum DSD Starterpaket „Durchfahrbarkeit des Skandinavien–Mittelmeer Korridors“ (Scan-Med). Das gegenständliche Projekt der DB InfraGO AG als Bestandteil des DSD-Starterpakets umfasst die Ausrüstung des Korridors Scan-Med München mit DStW-Technik und ETCS Level 2 ohne Signale (L2oS), es teilt sich in 2 Abschnitte, Strecke 5510 München - Rosenheim und Strecke 5703 Rosenheim - Freilassing. Die Investitionssumme für dieses Projekt wird mit ca. EUR 600,0 Mio. veranschlagt. Hiervon sind bereits ca. EUR 13,5 Mio. über einen bestehenden Vertrag abgerechnet worden. Der hier neu ausgeschriebene Versicherungsvertrag wird den bestehenden Vertrag ablösen. Es wird mit einer derzeit geplanten Bauzeit bis zum 31.12.2031 gerechnet. Der Versicherungsvertrag beginnt nach Beendigung des Ausschreibungsverfahrens mit dem Datum des Zuschlages im Anschluss an eine derzeit bestehende Vorlaufdeckung. (Typ M) In der Haftpflichtversicherung beträgt die Deckungssumme je Schadenfall EUR 25.000.000 pauschal für Personen-, Sach- und Vermögensschäden, einschließlich der Leistungen aus der Umwelthaftpflichtversicherung. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung steht eine separate Deckungssumme je Schadenfall von EUR 10.000.000 pauschal für Sach- und Vermögensschäden zur Verfügung. Die vorgenannten Summen sind dreifach maximiert. Die Extendend Maintenance im Teil Bauleistungs- und Montageversicherung beträgt 42 Monate. Die Nachhaftung beträgt in der Haftpflichtversicherung 10 Jahre, in der Umwelthaftpflicht- und Umweltschadenversicherung 5 Jahre. Der generelle Selbstbehalt beträgt mindestens EUR 25.000. Für Personenschäden entfällt der Selbstbehalt. Im Falle einer erweiterten Planungsdeckung beträgt der Selbstbehalt EUR 100.000

These amounts are based on historical data.

title: Germany – Architectural and related services – 2026-01 VGV Architektur Bürgerzentrum
description: Gebäudeplanung nach §§ 33 - 37 HOAI i.V.m. Anlage 10 HOAI, LPH 2 - 9.Die Gemeinde Randersacker beabsichtigt die Neukonzeption des Rathaus-Areals zum „Bürgerzentrum Randersacker“. Ziel ist es, unter Erhalt der denkmalgeschützten Rathausfassade den gestiegenen Raumbedarf der Verwaltung zu decken und zusätzlich Flächen für örtliche Vereine zu schaffen. Für die Umsetzung des erhöhten Flächenbedarfs steht der Bereich des leerstehenden Gebäudeteils "ehemals Beamtenwohnhaus" zur Verfügung. Das Gebäude soll aufgrund des Zustandes, der abweichenden Geschosshöhen, Raumzuschnitten und Brandschutzaspekten abgerissen werden. Die bestehenden Nutzungen (Weltkreisladen mit Touristen-Info, Festausschank, öffentliches WC) sind neu zu integrieren. Das gesamte Areal inklusive Vorplatz und Außenanlagen ist städtebaulich, gestalterisch, energetisch sowie durchgängig barrierefrei aufzuwerten.

title: Tampa Harbor Improvements Industry Day
description: This announcement constitutes a Special Notice. This announcement seeks information from industry and will only be used for preliminary planning purposes. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SPECIAL NOTICE. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the evaluation. This is a SAVE-THE-DATE special notice for an industry day event on 18 November 2026 at 9:00AM EST. All interested Offerors are required to access SAM.gov for future updates. Please view registration information and details below. The presentation slides and list of attendees will be made available and posted to the subject special notice on SAM.gov after the conclusion of the event. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Jacksonville District will be holding an Industry Day event to gauge the interest, capabilities, and qualifications of various members of the Construction Community, to include Small Businesses, and to also provide information and obtain feedback from interested Offerors prior to issuance of the official solicitation. This requirement is for fiscal year (FY) 2028 award. NAICS Code 237990: Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction Small Business Standard: $37 million Magnitude of Construction: $100 - $500 million Project Title: Tampa Harbor Improvements Industry Day. Purpose: The purpose of this scheduled Industry Day is to provide the latest information regarding the future advertisement and award of Contract 1 for the Tampa Harbor Deepening Project. The scheduled event will include a detailed presentation by the Jacksonville District US Army Corps of Engineers, Tampa Harbor Project Delivery Team (PDT) followed by open Q&A and 1-1 meeting opportunities with contracts to ask more in-depth questions and get feedback as the design and permitting moves forward. Project Description: The project includes construction dredging to deepen and widen specified areas within the federal navigation channel of Tampa Harbor. The project is planned for six (6) contracts over an estimated 8�10-year period. The Scope of Work for this Industry Day will be focused on Contract 1. Contract 1 work includes deepening of Cut-C (HB), Port Sutton Channel, Port Sutton Turning Basin, East Bay Channel and Cut-D (HB) to a depth of 49 feet MLLW, deepening the Port Sutton Terminal Channel to a depth of 44 feet MLLW, and deepening the East Bay Channel Extensions 1 and 2 to a depth of 41 feet MLLW. The Contract 1 work also includes widening of Port Sutton Channel, Port Sutton Turning Basin, and East Bay Channel. All areas of deepening and widening will incorporate +1 foot of allowable overdepth. All dredged material from the project will be disposed of in the East Bay Placement Area, DMMA 2-D and DMMA 3-D. Estimated quantities to be dredged are roughly 4.4 million cubic yards. Link to the Tampa Harbor Improvements USACE website: https://www.saj.usace.army.mil/Tampa-Harbor/-30-/ Event Date: Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at 9:00 AM EST. Event Location: Port of Tampa � Cruise Terminal 6 1331 McKay Street Tampa, Florida 33602 *Parking available onsite Contact Info: Manny Vianzon, Project Manager (904) 232-3292 Emmanuel.A.Vianzon@usace.army.mil If you cannot attend in person: Link Meeting: https://www.microsoft.com/EN-US/MICROSOFT-TEAMS/JOIN-A-MEETING Meeting ID: 993 212 869 457 Passcode: tG6Ff3Gt Join by phone: 604-262-2433 Phone conference ID: 972 118 411# NOTES: NO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COST ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO SAID NOTICE, ATTENDANCE AT THE VIRTUAL INDUSTRY DAY EVENT OR ANY FOLLOW-UP INFORMATION SUBSEQUENTLY REQUESTED. You must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) in order to receive a Government contract award. To register, go to www.sam.gov. For additional information visit the website for the Federal Service Desk (www.FSD.gov) which supports SAM or contact them at 866-606-8220 for assistance.

title: Office of Hazardous Materials Safety Research Initiative � FY2026 BROAD AGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT (BAA)
description: AMENDMENT 02 (09/21/2026): The purpose of this amendment is to incorporate PHMSA�s Responses to Vendor Inquiries regarding Phase I white paper submissions, subcontractor eligibility for foreign entities, submission limits, deadlines, and multi-topic proposals under the solicitation (See attached). All other terms and conditions of the solicitation remain unchanged. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- AMENDMENT 01 (08/24/2026): The purpose of this amendment is to (1) change the Phase I White Paper due date from December 22, 2026, to November 18, 2026, and (2) add the contact email address tremayne.terry@dot.gov to Section X.A. in Attachment 1- BAA Solicitation_PHMSA-26HM-BAA. All other terms and conditions of the solicitation remain unchanged. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Hazardous Materials Safety (OHMS), is soliciting white papers and full proposals under Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) PHMSA-26HM-BAA pursuant to FAR 35.016. The objective of this announcement is to award competitive research contracts that advance scientific, technical, engineering, and policy solutions to prevent incidents and enhance safety during the transportation of hazardous materials across all modes. Offerors are invited to submit innovative research proposals addressing one or more of the following core topic areas: 26HM-ESS (Efficient Safety Standards): Research to modernize safety standards and testing, streamline certification, leverage safety data, and evaluate risk landscapes to reduce regulatory burden while maintaining safety. 26HM-SST (Safe Energy Storage Technologies): Research assessing transportation risks of energy storage systems, battery chemistries, thermal runaway detection and mitigation, and critical mineral recovery. 26HM-IPG (Innovative Packaging): Development and evaluation of advanced packaging materials, containment designs, integrity monitoring, and predictive failure simulations. 26HM-RER (Risk Reduction for Emergency Response): Innovations, technologies, data analysis, and materials to enhance emergency responder safety, communication, and preparedness. 26HM-RTS (Hazardous Materials Rail Transportation Safety): Research advancing scientific understanding of rail tank car performance under derailment conditions, crashworthiness materials, thermal shielding, and predictive risk modeling. A two-phase selection process (Phase I: White Paper; Phase II: Invited Full Proposal) will be used. Awards will be procurement contracts (Firm-Fixed-Price or Cost-Reimbursement) up to $2,000,000 with a total performance period of up to 36 months. Full eligibility, formatting, and submission instructions are detailed in the solicitation document attached to this notice.

title: Personal Radiation Detector (PRD)
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) SUMMARY: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), Office of Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) requires Personal Radiation Detectors (PRDs). PRDs are pager-size devices worn by users for radiological and nuclear detection capability as well as personal protection. PRDs automatically monitor the environment and alert the user when radiation levels above the natural background are detected. PRDs also assist the user in localizing the source of detected radiation. The high sensitivity and rapid response time to the variations in the ambient radiation levels clearly distinguish PRDs from the family of electronic dosimeters which are mainly used for accurate dose and dose rate. GENERAL INFORMATION: This RFI is issued solely for information gathering purposes to identify offerors that can provide identify commercially available, gamma-detecting Personal Radiation Detectors (PRDs), including available wireless-communication and data-transmission capabilities in advance of an acquisition which will include testing of the most compliant candidate solutions. In accordance with FAR 15.201(e), RFIs may be used when the Government wants to obtain price, delivery, other market information, and capabilities for planning purposes. Responses to these RFIs are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. This RFI shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government for any purpose, nor does it restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition approach. Respondents are solely responsible for all expenses associated with their RFI response. Respondents will not receive additional information in response to their submittal to the RFI and will not be notified of the resulting market research. Interested parties must submit sufficient documentation in accordance with the instructions in this RFI and current industry�s best practices and standards, demonstrating their ability/experience to meet or exceed the Government�s requirements listed in this notice. RFI RESPONSE SUBMITTAL INSTRUCTIONS: Interested contractors shall submit their RFI responses electronically to Isaac Chapple, Contracting Officer, at Isaac.Chapple@fema.dhs.gov no later than 12:00PM Eastern Standard Time (EST), (due 11/18/2026).

title: Coburn Gore LPOE Art in Architecture Project
description: Document Added & Updated: 0332CG-AIA- Coburn Gore AIA Questions & Answers V3 Dated 07 October 2026 The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) Art in Architecture Program commissions American artists (citizens and Lawful Permanent Residents or Permanent Workers of the United States) to create publicly scaled and permanently installed artworks for Federal buildings nationwide. GSA announces an opportunity for a Federal art commission in conjunction with the new construction of the Coburn Gore Land Port of Entry (LPOE) in Coburn, Maine. The new facility will strengthen supply chains, improve operational capabilities and facility infrastructure, spur economic growth, and bolster the country�s security. The project will provide a fully operational LPOE that coordinates with the tra?c ?ow and operations of the Canadian port of entry at Saint-Augustin-de-Woburn Quebec, Port of Entry. The project will provide a new port that allows Customs and Border Protection to more efficiently carry out its agency mission, their operations and interactions with the public. GSA allocates one-half of one percent (0.5%) of the estimated construction costs of new or modernized Federal facilities for art commissions. The art budget for this project is estimated to be between $275,000 to $400,000. One or more artists will be awarded a fixed-price contract for a commission. Artists who wish to be considered for this GSA art commission must submit application materials to GSA by the SAM Contract Opportunity�s Response Date. Artists may also elect to be considered for all future GSA art commissions by submitting application materials to GSA�s National Artist Registry (Registry). Instructions on how to submit application materials and join the Registry are available on the following Web site: https://www.gsa.gov/real-estate/design-and-construction/art-in-architecturefine-arts/art-in-architecture-program/art-in-architecture-national-artist-registry All artists who wish to be considered as candidates for a commission at the LPOE in Coburn Gore, ME must have their application materials submitted and received by GSA by 12:00 PM Eastern Time on 18 November 2026. Artists� submissions received after the deadline will not be considered for this project but will be eligible for consideration on future GSA commissions alongside the other artists on the Registry. Artists already on the Registry need not resubmit but may elect to update their information prior to the deadline. GSA evaluates artists based on the following criteria: the media, materials, content and style of the artist�s past work, along with the artist�s past performance and experience with commissions or projects similar to the one described in this synopsis. Shortlisted artists will be contacted and asked to submit additional information, including a statement that the artist can perform the work associated with the GSA commission within the identified budget. GSA will count the combined weight of all the selection criteria as significantly more important than price. At minimum, the scope of services for this commission will require collaboration with the lead designer selected for the land port of entry project; travel to the project site; development and presentation of preliminary and final concepts; fabrication of the artwork; participation in meetings and conservation reviews as necessary; delivery and installation of the artwork; professional documentation of, and detailed maintenance planning for the artwork at the project site. For informational purposes: Artists selected for the contract award must be Permanent Residents or Citizens of the United States of America. Artists selected for the contract award will be required to have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of award. Instructions for creating an account and activating registration in SAM may be found at www.sam.gov. Artists selected for the contract award will be required to renew the registration in SAM on an annual basis for the duration of the project. In accordance with Executive Order (EO) 13934, agencies should prioritize the commission of works of art that portray historically significant Americans or events of American historical significance or illustrate the ideals upon which our Nation was founded. Inquiries concerning the project should be directed to the following email address: Molly.Lewis@gsa.gov and reference the synopsis number in the subject line. No questions will be answered after 07 October 2026 12:00pm EST.

title: End of the World Long Term Stewardship
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Proposals are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 12363N26R4016 is issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP) for the End of the World G-Z Long-Term IRSC (EOTW G-Z LTIRSC). The End of the World Project area is approximately 50,000 acres on the Salmon River Ranger District of the Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forest. The End of the World EIS authorizes commercial treatment on over 17,000 acres primarily through intermediate harvest. The purpose of the EOTW G-Z LTIRSC is to thin overstocked stands to reduce the risk of catastrophic wildfire as well as improve stand health. The EOTW Project is within the Wildland Urban Interface and has numerous private inholdings with seasonal and permanent residents. This contracting tool will increase the pace and scale of active management beyond the current capacity of staffing levels. A secondary objective of the EOTW G-Z LTIRSC is to provide a steady, dependable supply of timber and forest products to local facilities. This project aligns with Secretarial Memo 1078-006 and the Implementation of Secretarial Memo 1078-006 dated April 3, 2025 to utilize long term stewardship contracts for active management. This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 113310 and the small business size standard is 500 Employees This acquisition is an unrestricted requirement. All responsible sources may submit a proposal and offer which will be considered by the agency. Proposals are to be submitted via email to Mark Phillipp at mark.phillipp@usda.gov and Matt Daigle at matthew.daigle@usda.gov.

title: NGA HRM-II RFP
description: The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) is to issue this Request for Proposal (RFP) HM047626R0018 for public response for the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) Human Resource Management II (HRM II). The HRM II RFP will be a commercial effort under FAR Part 12, and the Government anticipates using Best Value � Tradeoff evaluation methods and acquisition procedures as described in FAR Part 15. Contract award will be made to the offeror who provides the best overall value to the Government in terms of evaluation factors listed in Section 5 of the RFP. The procurement will be conducted using full and open competition procedures. The Government contemplates award of a performance-based contract using Firm Fixed Price (FFP) and Time-and-Materials (T&M) CLINs resulting from the solicitation. The period performance is anticipated to be a one (1) year base period with four (4) twelve (12) month option periods. The HRM II acquisition includes: The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency requires comprehensive Human Resource Management support services across the employee lifecycle. The requirement includes support for functions such as personnel data processing, talent acquisition support, talent development support, strategic workforce planning, employee support services, performance records management, benefits processing, retirement tracking, and related HR management support activities. In order to be considered for this requirement, the offeror shall have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM), https://www.sam.gov. Offerors may obtain information on SAM registration and annual confirmation requirements by calling 1-866-606-8220 or via the internet at https://www.sam.gov. title: Automated Ultrasound-Based, Super Intelligence (SI)-Enabled Fracture Detection
description: The Center for Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA) intends to use responses to this Sources Sought Notice (SSN) for planning purposes. BARDA will not award any contracts under this Notice, but rather seeks current and forecasted prices, inventories, capabilities, and other pertinent marketplace data. This Notice is issued by the Center for Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA) to identify innovative medical countermeasure technologies to enable rapid triage of musculoskeletal injuries such as fractures and soft tissue injuries of extremities. This request is for information only and is intended to assess the current state of commercially available technologies and technologies nearing commercial availability that support automated ultrasound-based fracture detection using technologies commonly known as Artificial Intelligence (AI). Consistent with Executive Order 14434, �Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence,� AI- technologies are now referred to as Super Intelligence (SI) throughout this notice, including in the title and should be referred the same in the response. The Center for Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA) intends to use responses to this Sources Sought Notice (SSN) to inform planning for the potential acquisition of ultrasound-based devices capable of capturing and displaying anatomical data. Potential acquisition and inventory approaches include device purchases or leases supported by vendor-managed inventory (VMI) arrangements. BARDA seeks information on technologies that could assist clinical care providers in visualizing or detecting musculoskeletal injuries, including fractures and soft tissue injuries, to support triage and initial treatment in emergency departments, urgent care centers, and field settings. These devices could also support continued evaluation and treatment in definitive orthopedic care settings, consistent with applicable regulatory authorizations and intended uses. The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) leads Federal public health and medical preparedness and response efforts, including supporting the research, development, acquisition, and availability of medical countermeasures (MCMs). These efforts address the health consequences of chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) threats, pandemic influenza, and emerging infectious diseases, including threats arising from deliberate, accidental, or naturally occurring events. This SSN supports planning for medical capabilities that could strengthen the Nation�s preparedness for and response to emergencies involving traumatic injuries. The Project BioShield Act of 2004 (Pub. L. No. 108-276) established authorities for procuring qualifying security countermeasures for the Strategic National Stockpile (SNS). The Pandemic and All-Hazards Preparedness Act of 2006 (Pub. L. No. 109-417) further strengthened the Nation�s medical countermeasure development and preparedness framework. The National Health Security Strategy 2023�2026 provides additional strategic context for strengthening preparedness, response, and recovery capabilities. Consistent with these preparedness objectives, this Sources Sought Notice seeks information on potential approaches to improve the availability and accessibility of relevant medical devices across health care settings. Approaches of interest include purchase, lease, vendor-managed inventory (VMI), and arrangements that combine access to devices with maintenance and readiness support. Information received will inform acquisition planning and assessment of these approaches, subject to applicable statutory authorities, acquisition requirements, and availability of funds. These documents represent the foundation for addressing the Nation�s CBRN MCM needs. Amongst the foundational documents referenced above, musculoskeletal injuries such as fractures resulting from nuclear blast explosions and structural collapse, as well as and other mass casualty events present significant challenges in both field and clinical settings which require prompt diagnosis for adjudication and triage of patients. Current standards of care rely heavily on radiography and CT imaging, which are often unavailable, delayed, or resource-constrained in austere environments, disaster response settings, or during patient surge conditions. Delayed or missed fracture diagnosis can worsen patient outcomes and burden downstream care. BARDA is seeking solutions that enhance the speed, accuracy, and accessibility of fracture detection at the point of injury and point of care, without dependence on traditional imaging infrastructure. CAPABILITY STATEMENT/INFORMATION SOUGHT This Sources Sought Notice (SSN) seeks information from small business (SB) and other than small business (OTSB) concerns regarding their qualifications, experience, and capabilities to develop, manufacture, and deploy standalone, point-of-care, super intelligence (SI)-enabled ultrasound devices for fracture detection. Respondents shall provide only the information, data, and materials necessary to demonstrate their capabilities relevant to this notice. Responses shall include separate Technical Representation and Business Representation sections, as detailed below. Each section shall not exceed 10 single-sided pages, including all attachments, r�sum�s, charts, and other supporting materials, and shall use 12-point Times New Roman font. Pages exceeding the limit for either section will not be reviewed. Respondents shall identify their business size status as either small business or other than small business under the NAICS code and corresponding size standard identified in this notice. Technical Representations Respondents shall provide the technical information requested by ASPR/BARDA in separately numbered sections, in the order listed below. For any section that does not apply, respondents shall retain the section number and heading, mark it �Not Applicable,� and briefly explain why it does not apply. Response Specification In response to this notice, clearly describe the capability and experience that meets the criteria specified in the subsequent categories. A template is provided for detailed and concise responses as related to the qualifying criteria. Additional supporting evidence, data, and information can be provided as attachments, not to exceed the 10-page limit per submission to this notice. All sponsors responding to this notice are required to provide the requested information on their products and capabilities by providing short responses, summarizing their device's diagnostic capability along with performance data, TRL and development status, regulatory documentation, product IFU, manufacturing overview, and supply-chain and production information. The narrative response to the templated prompts may include figures, schematics, diagrams, photographs, etc. and shall describe the proposed final product under consideration. Any proposed device must qualify against the following criteria (either work completed or demonstratable work in progress): Display and Diagnostic of Anatomy for Fracture Evaluation Capability Automated ultrasound imaging-based volumetric capture and display of detailed anatomy of different structures and providing bone detection/identification in areas such as wrist, ankles and others; and assist care providers to visualize clinically significant injuries such as fractures. Embedded ultrasound image processing information with appropriately trained Super Intelligence and machine learning (SI/ML) models to assist in image acquisition and segmentation for data interpretation with predefined sensitivity/specificity performance, which has been reviewed and adjudicated in FDA submissions for 510k clearance process. Models must be rigorously tested/validated against independent datasets separate from their training and their performance must improve upon that of human imaging

Solicitation: 36C25227B0002 Project: 550-20-121: Demo Old Boiler Plant B100 (CON) Location: VA Illiana Health Care System (VAIHCS) 1900 East Main Street Danville, IL 61832 VA Illiana Health Care System (VAIHCS) has a requirement to demolish old boiler plant in Building 100 in accordance with the project drawings and specifications. Work includes general construction, demolition, removal of underground storage tank, traditional asbestos abatement, lead-based paint removal and disposal, and certain other items. Contractor shall Furnish all labor, materials, supplies, equipment, tools, supervision, management, and all other necessary resources required for Project #550-20-121 Demo Old Boiler Plant B100 as required by the drawings and specifications. The Period of Performance is One Hundred Eighty (180) calendar days from the Notice to Proceed (NTP). The NTP shall be issued approximately 14 calendar days after award once required payment and performance bonds and certificate of insurance is provided. The solicitation, specifications and drawings will be posted on www.SAM.gov. There will be a pre-bid conference held for this project and all prospective bidders are strongly encouraged to attend. Details of the pre-bid conference will be included in the solicitation package. Pursuant to Public Law 109-461, this solicitation is set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) firms. In accordance with VAAR 819.7003(DEVIATION) (b), at the time of submission of bids, and at the time of award of any contract, the offeror must represent to the CO that it is a (1) SDVOSB eligible under VAAR Subpart 819.70; (2) Small business concern under the NAICS code assigned to this acquisition; and (3) Certified SDVOSB listed in the SBA certification database at https://veterans.certify.sba.gov/ (see 13 CFR 128). The solicitation will be issued on or about October 8, 2026. The bidder is responsible for monitoring and downloading any amendments from SAM.gov which may be issued to this solicitation. The magnitude of the requirement is between $1,000,000.00 and $2,000,000.00. The North American Industry Classification Code (NAICS) for this procurement is 236220 Commercial and Institutional Building Construction; small business $45 Million size standard applies.

title: Breathing Air Systems Services for Fire Emergency Services at EAFB and P42
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services under RFO Part 12. This notice, together with all attached documents, constitutes the complete solicitation. Quotes are requested; a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number FA930127Q0003 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ). The Government intends to establish a single Basic Ordering Agreement for commercial annual preventive maintenance, unscheduled emergency repair, and certified quarterly air quality sampling services on high-pressure breathing air compressor systems (Bauer TCOM-26, Bauer DOTR26-WRAF, and Stallion Centaur) supporting Fire Emergency Services at Edwards AFB, CA and Air Force Plant 42, Palmdale, CA. The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, tools, materials, supervision, and other items necessary to perform the services in the attached Statement of Work. NAICS 811310 / Size Standard $12.5 Million. This acquisition is Full and Open Competition. Award will be made to the responsible offeror whose quote provides the best value after comparative evaluation of Technical Capability, Past Performance, and Price. No formal adjectival or numerical ratings will be assigned. Full quote preparation instructions and evaluation factors are contained in Sections L and M of the solicitation. All questions must be submitted in writing to christopher.barnes.50@us.af.mil and alexia.del_real@us.af.mil no later than 1400 PDT on 26 October 2026. The Government intends to post consolidated answers by amendment on or about 30 October 2026. Late questions may not be answered. Offerors that will handle Federal Contract Information must complete a CMMC Level 1 self-assessment in accordance with R-DFARS 252.204-7021 and the attached guidance, and post the assessment in SPRS. Quotes must be submitted electronically by the date and time stated in the solicitation. The Government reserves the right to award without discussions.

title: Primer Feed Mechanisms (PFMs)
description: The U.S. Army Contracting Command - New Jersey, on behalf of the office of the Project Manager, Combat Ammunition Systems (PM CAS), intends to issue a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Primer Feed Mechanisms (PFMs) in support of the M777A2 155mm Howitzer. The PFM Assembly consists of three assemblies: (1) Body Assembly, (2) Tray Assembly, and (3) Magazine Assembly, and each assembly consists of several sub-assemblies. In addition to the PFM Assembly, the Dog Coupler Assembly (legacy), Reinforced Dog Coupler Assembly, Magazine Primer Stop, Injector Arm Assembly, Firing Pin, Cross Pin, and Inert Primers are considered down parts to the overarching PFM assemblies.Specifications: The contractor shall manufacture, test, and deliver Primer Feed Mechanism (PFM) assemblies and associated components for the M777A2 Lightweight 155mm Howitzer to support U.S. or Foreign Military Sales customers. Specific detailed packaging instructions will be included on the delivery order on a case-by-case basis.Planned Acquisition: The Government intends to award a single, five-year Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract with Firm Fixed Price (FFP) delivery orders with five one-year Ordering Periods (OPs) from Fiscal Year (FY) 27-32. The production contract award will be based upon Full and Open Competition as a 100% Small Business Set Aside, in accordance with FAR 19.5.The following Ordering Periods are anticipated:OP 1: 12 months from date of awardOP 2: 12 months from the end of OP 1OP 3: 12 months from the end of OP 2OP 4: 12 months from the end of OP 3OP 5: 12 months from the end of OP 4. **This is a notice that Solicitation W15QKN-26-R-A044 is being placed on hold until further notice. The Government will provide notice when the solicitation is active again. For administrative purposes, the closing date is extended to November 18, 2026, to prevent system closure. Proposal submission is not required until further notice.**

description: The contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision necessary to remove and replace ten (10) existing inpatient restroom Patient Care Units (PCUs) with VA-approved fixed-type toilet, sink, cabinet, and countertop assemblies. Work includes demolition of existing units, reuse of existing plumbing connections, wall repair and painting, installation of new PCUs, and installation of new privacy curtain tracks and curtains. All work shall be performed in an occupied healthcare environment while minimizing disruptions to facility operations and maintaining access to adjacent spaces. The required period of performance is 180 calendar days from Notice to Proceed.

Cage _______ ref. no. ;03956 4803475-1; 3.2 Marking - This item shall be physically identified in accordance with ;MIL-STD-130, REV N, 16 NOV 2012; . 3.3 Changes in Design, Material Servicing, or Part Number - Except for a Code 1 change, which shall be processed as provided in the code statement shown below, no substitution of items shall be made until the NAVICP-MECH Contracting Officer has notified and approval has been given by issuance of a written change order. When any change in design, material, servicing or part number is made to replace or substitute any item to be furnished on this contract/purchase order, the Contractor shall furnish, for the substituting/replacement item, a drawing and an explanation of the reason for the change, explaining the reason therefor. When notifying the Procurement Contracting Officer of the reasons for making substitutions, the type of change shall be indicated by code number in accordance with one of the following statements: Code 1: PART NUMBER CHANGE ONLY - If the Manufacturer's Part Number indicated thereon has changed, but the parts are identical in all respects, supply the item and advise NAVICP-MECH immediately of the new part number. Code 2: Assembly (or set or kit) not furnished - Used following detail parts. Code 3: Part not furnished separately - Use assembly. Code 4: Part redesigned - Old and new parts are completely interchangeable. Code 5: Part redesigned - New part replaces old. Old part cannot replace new. Code 6: Part redesigned - Parts not interchangeable. 3.4 Mercury Free - The material supplied under this contract/purchase order is intended for use on submarines/surface ships and therefore shall contain no metallic mercury and shall be free from mercury contamination. Mercury contamination of the material will be cause for rejection. If the inclusion of metallic mercury is required as a functional part of the material furnished under this contract, the Contractor shall obtain written approval from the Procurement Contracting Officer before proceeding with manufacture. The contractor's request shall explain in detail the requirements for mercury, identify specifically the parts to contain mercury, and explain the method of protection against mercury escape. Such a request will be forwarded directly to the Procurement Contracting Officer with a copy to the applicable Government Inspector. Upon approval by the Contracting Officer, the vendor will provide a "Warning Plate" stating that metallic mercury is a functional part of the item and will include name and location of that part. The use of mercury, mercury compounds, or mercury-bearing instruments and/or equipment in a manner which might cause contamination in the manufacture, assembly, or test of material on this contract is prohibited. The most probable causes of contamination are direct-connected manometers, mercury vacuum pumps, mercury seals, or the handling of mercury in the immediate vicinity. Mercury switches, mercury in glass thermometers, standard cells and other items containing mercury may be used if they are located so as not to constitute a contamination hazard. If external contamination by metallic mercury occurs or is suspected, the following test may be used to determine whether contamination by metallic mercury exists or whether corrective cleaning measures have been effective. Enclose the equipment in a polyethylene bag or close-fitting airtight container for eight hours at room temperature (70 degrees F minimum).Sample the trapped air and if mercury vapor concentration is 0.01 mg/cu meter or more, the material is mercury contaminated insofar as the requirements of this contract are concern

title: Tax Software and Support
description: The IRS has an ongoing requirement for commercial tax software products and associated services supporting the Federal Tax Compliance mission. The anticipated contract will provide software licenses, customization, software maintenance, integration, training, and user and technical support. The requirement includes, but is not limited to: Up to 130 Tax Analyzer licenses and annual renewals; Up to 150 Tax Planner licenses and annual renewals; Tax software user and technical support/help desk services; Maintenance of IRS-customized Issue Management System (IMS) Tax Engine Middleware; Support and maintenance of the Tax Engine Middleware Plug-In; Software customization and integration; Annual face-to-face training for up to 25 participants; Quarterly virtual training for licensed users; Software updates, upgrades, patches, and enhancements; Integration and testing support; and Associated program management, cybersecurity, documentation, and technical support services. Anticipated Period of Performance Base Period: December 18, 2026 - December 17, 2027 Option Period 1: December 18, 2027 - December 17, 2028 Option Period 2: December 18, 2028 - December 17, 2029 Option Period 3: December 18, 2029 - December 17, 2030 Option Period 4: December 18, 2030 - December 17, 2031 The government anticipates awarding a single firm-fixed-price contract utilizing a Best-Value Tradeoff (BVTO) source selection approach in accordance with FAR 15.101-1. Proposals will be evaluated based on the following factors, listed in descending order of importance: Technical Approach Licensing, Middleware Integration & Support Capability Past Performance Price The combined non-price factors are significantly more important than price. Award will be made to the responsible offeror whose proposal represents the best value to the government, considering price and non-price factors. The government intends to award without discussions; however, it reserves the right to conduct discussions if determined necessary by the Contracting Officer. Questions and Proposal Submission Questions Due: October 30, 2026, at 4:00 PM Eastern Time. Proposals Due: November 18, 2026, at 4:00 PM Eastern Time. All questions and proposals shall be submitted electronically via email to both: louis.c.browniii@irs.gov tanya.r.burnett@irs.gov Offerors shall submit proposals in accordance with Section L, Instructions, Conditions, and Notices to Offerors, and Section M, Evaluation Factors for Award, of the attached solicitation. Interested offerors are encouraged to carefully review the solicitation and all accompanying attachments for complete technical requirements, proposal instructions, evaluation criteria, and applicable terms and conditions. Any amendments, clarifications, or updates to this solicitation will be posted on SAM.gov. Offerors are responsible for monitoring SAM.gov for updates and amendments throughout the solicitation period.

title: Cross Over Network Waveguide Assembly Qualification and Production (P/Ns G638416-1)
description: The United States Government is conducting market research to identify potential sources that may possess the expertise, capabilities, and experience to meet the requirements for qualification and production of X-Band Cross Over Network. Security Requirements: The level of security clearance and amount of foreign participation in this requirement has not been determined; however, the Contractor should anticipate working with teams consisting of military, civilian, national partners, and contract personnel from various services and agencies. DISCLAIMER: THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP), REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ) OR AN INVITATION FOR BID (IFB). IN ACCORDANCE WITH FAR 15.201(e), THIS NOTICE DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM ARE NOT OFFERS AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT AS A RESULT OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT.NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION OF RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. THE GOVERNMENT MAY USE THE INFORMATION OBTAINED FROM RESPONSES TO THIS NOTICE IN DETERMINING ITS ACQUISITION APPROACH. THE ISSUANCE OF THIS NOTICE DOES NOT RESTRICT THE GOVERNMENT ACQUISTION APPROACH. The documents below contain a description of the Cross Over Network requirements, technical data package, and a Contractor Capability Survey. The Survey allows Contractors to provide their company's capability. Attention Small Business Respondents who are interested in participation for this effort: 1. No set aside decision has been made; however, the USG will determine the final strategy after thorough analysis of the small business responses and other market research available, considering the demonstrated interest and capability. Please ensure that you provide a thorough response to each question. If you company does not currently possess the full capability required to fulfill the entire requirment, what teaming/partnership/joint venture/subctonracting arrangements do you have in place to fulfill the Government's needs? Provide evidence of this arrangement e.g. emails, letter, etcl. that demonstrate a united response to this Sources Sought is highly encouraged, but not required. The evidence should state the type of arrangement and the role each member will fulfill. If you are only interested in being a subcontractor to the future awardee, state the portion of the work your organization has capability of fulfilling. 2. Identify any areas of work that your organization believes should be broken out exclusively for Small Businesses. Both Large and Small Businesses are encouraged to participate in this Market Research. Joint Ventures or Teaming Arrangements are encouraged. Questions relative to this market survey should be addressed to Brandon Jones, Contracting Officer, AFLCMC/ESGK-R (brandon.jones.96@us.af.mil) and Elizabeth Fuller (elizabeth.fuller.2@us.af.mil), Lead System Engineer, and Robert Cowden (robert.cowden.ctr@us.af.mil). title: Third Party Liability (TPL) Insurance for All Embassy Vehicles (OFV)
description: Dear Prospective Quoter: Enclosed is a Request for Quotations (RFQ) for Third Party Liability Insurance (TPL). If you would like to submit quotation, follow the instructions in Section 3 of the solicitation, complete the required portions of the attached document, and submit it to the address shown on Standard Form 1449 that follows this letter. The U.S. Government intends to award a contract/purchase order to the responsible company submitting an acceptable offer at the lowest price. We intend to award a contract/purchase order based on initial quotations, without holding discussions, although we may hold discussions with companies in the competitive range if there is a need to do so. Quotations are due by Wednesday, November 18, 2026 (no quotations will be accepted after this time). Proposals must be in English and incomplete proposals will not be accepted. Your quotation must be submitted electronically to RiyadhContracting@state.gov . The subject line of all emails must, at a minimum, read: �Request for Quotations � 19SA7027Q0005�. It is important to make sure the submission is made in specific size and format such as MS-Word 2007/2010, MS-Excel 2007/2010 or Adobe Acrobat (pdf file). In addition, file sizes must not exceed 30MB. If the file size should exceed 30MB, then please submit separate emails which are less than 30MB each. If multiple emails are submitted, please identify in the subject line the sequential order for each email (for example, if submitting two separate emails, you would include the following information: Email 1 of 2; Email 2 of 2). In order for a quotation to be considered, you must also complete and submit the following: SF-1449 Section I, Pricing Section 5 Representations and Certifications Additional information as required in Section 3 Proof of SAM Registration Offerors shall be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) database at https://www.sam.gov prior to submittal of their offer/proposal as prescribed under FAR 4.1102. Failure to be registered at time of proposal submission may deem the offeror�s proposal to be considered non-responsible and no further consideration will be given. Therefore, offerors are highly encouraged to register immediately if they are interested in submitting a response to this requirement. title: Requirement to support the Formerly Used Defense Sites (FUDS) Program Single Award Task Order Contract (SATOC)
description: This Sources Sought announcement is for market research purposes only and should not be construed as a solicitation. There is no entitlement to payment by the Government of direct or indirect costs or charges that arise as a result of the submission of information in response to this request for information (RFI). The Government shall not be liable for or suffer any consequential damages for any improperly identified proprietary information. Proprietary information will be safeguarded in accordance with the applicable Government regulations. The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Savannah District is considering the solicitation and subsequent award of a Single Award Task Order Contract (SATOC) in support of the Formerly Used Defense Sites (FUDS) program. This requirement is for comprehensive support for the Formerly Used Defense Sites (FUDS) Program. The draft SOW defines the scope of program management, administrative, logistical, and community relations services necessary to execute and document FUDS projects. The range of activities includes maintaining and updating the FUDSMIS database, ensuring project documentation remains current, supporting Project Managers in developing and revising Project Management Plans and Site Management Action Plans, records management, preparation and coordination of key project documents, document uploads to the FUDS Documents portal, Cost-to-Complete estimate processes, logistics and community outreach support (including PDT and public meetings, Restoration Advisory Board activities, fact sheets, ROEs, and Section 508-compliant materials), and identification and implementation of efficiencies and streamlining measures. The Contractor shall undertake these support activities to achieve program objectives across FUDS projects and sites. Submission Instructions: Please follow the link below to access the survey.

title: Netherlands – Canteen and catering services – EA Cateringvoorzieningen
description: De aan te besteden Opdracht betreft de verzorging van de cateringvoorzieningen in de in de volgende paragraaf genoemde locaties. Onder deze voorzieningen behoren: - De verkoop van eten en drinken aan studenten en medewerkers in uitgiftepunten - Verzorgen van banqueting in de vorm van onder andere: • vergader- en lunchservices • avondmaaltijden • evenementen - De exploitatie van vendingautomaten Het gaat hierbij om 9 locaties, echter zal een belangrijke ontwikkeling betreffende de transformatie en uitbreiding van de locatie aan de Wandelboslaan 1 tot Campus Wandelbos plaatsvinden. Op deze campus worden verschillende mbo-opleidingen en ondersteunende diensten van Yonder samengebracht. Naar verwachting zullen circa 1.300 studenten en 425 medewerkers gebruikmaken van deze locatie. Een deel van hen volgt een BBL-opleiding en is daardoor niet dagelijks op de campus aanwezig. Campus Wandelbos wordt voorzien van een restaurant voor studenten en medewerkers. De oplevering is voorzien in december 2026, waarna de eerste lessen volgens de huidige planning in januari 2027 plaatsvinden. Daarnaast worden de gebouwen en de buitenruimte van Campus Stappegoor in de periode 2026–2030 gefaseerd vernieuwd en verduurzaamd. De werkzaamheden kunnen tijdelijk of structureel gevolgen hebben voor studenten- en medewerkersstromen, de bereikbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van cateringvoorzieningen en de wijze waarop de dienstverlening op deze campus wordt georganiseerd. Naar verwachting zullen circa 3.000 studenten en 475 medewerkers gebruikmaken van deze locatie.

title: Germany – General construction work for pipelines – Lieferung und Montage von GFK-Rohrleitungen (DN 2000 / 2200) - Projekt Flusswärmepumpe 3 Mannheim
description: Die MVV Flusswärme GmbH (Tochterunternehmen der MVV Energie AG) (MVV) plant am Standort der Großkraftwerk Mannheim AG (GKM) in Mannheim-Neckarau die Errichtung und den Betrieb einer Flusswasser-Wärmepumpenanlage (WPA3) mit einer Heizleistung von bis zu 120 MWth. Dabei wird der Rhein als Wärmequelle über die bestehende Kühlwasserinfrastruktur des GKM und neu zu verlegende GFK-Rohrleitungen (DN 2000 / 2200) an die Wärmepumpenanlage angebunden. Die Ausschreibung umfasst die Planung, Lieferung und betriebsfertige Montage von GFK-Rohrleitungen sowie die dazugehörigen Tiefbauarbeiten. Zu den Planungsaufgaben zählen unter anderem Rohrleitungsberechnungen, Isometrien, Rohrstatiken, Kollisionsprüfungen sowie die Erstellung von Abnahmeprotokollen und Fertigungsunterlagen. Der Leistungsumfang beinhaltet die Installation von DN 2000- und DN 2200-GFK-Rohrleitungen, die Errichtung eines Kraftschlussbeckens im Rohrleitungsverlauf, den temporären Rückbau und Neubau bestehender Entwässerungsleitungen DN 400 bis DN 800 aus Beton / Stahlbeton sowie Aushub-, Verfüll- und Wiederherstellungsarbeiten. Die durchzuführenden Arbeiten sind unter Berücksichtigung der betrieblichen Abläufe der GKM abschnittsweise auszuführen.

title: Germany – Joinery and carpentry installation work – Anna-Susanna-Stieg 3 - Tischler Einbaumöbel
description: SBH | Schulbau Hamburg hat als Landesbetrieb der Freien und Hansestadt Hamburg (nachstehend SBH genannt) die Aufgabe, die Schulimmobilien unter Berücksichtigung der schulischen Belange nach wirtschaftlichen Grundsätzen zu planen, zu bauen, zu unterhalten und zu bewirtschaften und die mehr als 400 Schulen an die Behörde für Schule und Berufsbildung (BSB) zu vermieten. --------------- Die Grundschule Anna-Susanna-Stieg wird um ein multifunktionales Klassengebäude mit Mensa, Vitalküche und Einfeldsporthalle ergänzt. Der Neubau würde dabei erstmals die Bildung von mindestens fünfzügigen Jahrgangszentren ermöglichen. Im Osten schließt sich der neue, zentrale Schulhof an und im Süden sowie zwischen den Sporthallen sind die Außensportflächen vorgesehen. --------------- Hier: Tischler Einbaumöbel --------------- Bei den zu erbringenden Leistungen handelt es sich um Tischlerarbeiten für die Werkplanung, Fertigung, Lieferung und Montage von maßgefertigten Einbaumöbeln in Schulgebäuden. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst die Erstellung der Werkplanung nach örtlichem Aufmaß sowie die Herstellung und Montage verschiedener Möbel- und Ausstattungselemente aus Holzwerkstoffen einschließlich aller erforderlichen Beschläge, Oberflächenbehandlungen, Polsterungen, Befestigungen und Anpassungsarbeiten. Die Leistungen werden schlüsselfertig bis zur betriebsbereiten Übergabe erbracht.

title: Germany – Building construction work – Stadt Bochum: Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer Grundschule in der Vöde, Castroper Str. 235
description: Die Stadt Bochum (nachfolgend "Auftraggeber") steht als Schulträger vor der Herausforderung, dem stetig wachsenden Raumbedarf aufgrund der steigenden Schulanmeldungen im Bochumer Stadtgebiet zu entsprechen. In diesem Zusammenhang herrscht - neben dem Erfordernis an Sanierungs- und Erhaltungsmaßnahmen bereits bestehender Schulgebäude - ein erheblicher Bedarf an der Schaffung neuer Sport- und Lernräume. Dabei ist der Auftraggeber nach dem Schulgesetz verpflichtet, Schulentwicklungsplanung zu betreiben. Zur Erfüllung dieser ihr gesetzlich obliegenden Pflicht plant der Auftraggeber dem wachsenden Raumbedarf im Rahmen eines umfassenden Schulbau- und Schulmodernisierungsprogramm zu begegnen. Dieses beinhaltet erforderliche Neubau-, Umbau- und Sanierungsmaßnahmen für 27 schulische Einrichtungen. Das Programm umfasst dabei alle Schularten und bezieht sich auf Grund-, Förder- und weiterführende Schulen. Eingebettet in dieses Schulbauprogramm soll nun die Erweiterung und der Umbau der Grundschule in der Vöde, Castroper Str. 235, 44791 Bochum erfolgen. Die bauliche Erweiterung sowie der Umbau der Grundschule in der Vöde nebst vorgelagertem Rückbau der Bestandsbauung soll durch einen Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer erfolgen. Die Grundschule in der Voede ist eine zweizügige Schule im Stadtteil Grumme. Die vorhandene Schüleranzahl von ca. 235 SuS (SJ 2026/27) wird bis zum Schuljahr 2030/31 auf prognostizierte 240 SuS anwachsen. Auf dem Grundstück befindet sich das Schulgebäude (ca. 468 m²), eine Trafostation (ca. 65 m²), eine Turnhalle (ca. 565 m²), die ehemalige Hausmeisterwohnung, die nun als OGS genutzt wird (ca. 132 m²) und ein an die Halle angebautes weiteres OGS-Gebäude (ca. 195 m²). Die Schulhoffläche beträgt ca. 2.100 m². Die geplante Maßnahme soll in drei Schritten realisiert werden: Schritt 1: Umbau Computerraum zu einem Klassenraum - bereits erfolgt; Ein Computerraum, der nicht mehr benötigt wurde, wurde zu einem Klassenraum umgebaut. Schritt 2: Containeranlage als zusätzlicher Klassenraum - bereits erfolgt; Ein Container vor dem Hauptgebäude an der Castroper Straße bietet Platz für einen weiteren Raum. Schritt 3: Rückbau des bestehenden Anbaus an die Turnhalle (OGS), Neubau und Umbau auf dem Schulhof (SJ 2030/31); Entlang der westlichen Grundstücksgrenze ist die Errichtung eines dreigeschossigen Neubaus vorgesehen. Da die nutzbare Schulhoffläche während der Bauphase erheblich eingeschränkt wird, soll der bestehende Anbau an die Turnhalle (Räumlichkeiten der OGS) vor der Ausführung des Neubaus zurückgebaut werden. Die entsprechenden Räume sollen im zweiten Obergeschoss des Neubaus untergebracht werden. Nach Abschluss der Neubauarbeiten erfolgen die erforderlichen Umbaumaßnahmen im Bestandsgebäude.

title: Norway – Postal services related to newspapers and periodicals – Procurement of newspaper distribution
description: The competition concerns agreements on a duty to deliver newspapers by subscription to locations without other newspaper distribution, in accordance with the Law on Postal Services dated 4 September 2015 no. 91 ("The Post Act") §§ 6 and 7 other sections, cf. the regulations on post by 18 September 2015 no. 1063 ("The Postal Regulations") § 19. The service is characterised as a service of general economic importance. The procurement will be carried out in accordance with the EEA agreement ́s rules on public support and the so-called Altmark criteria. The Ministry of Transport ("the Contracting Authority") shall procure newspaper distribution on three scheduled weekdays (Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays). Such services shall be provided in the geographical area stated in the Requirement Specifications in Annexes 1.3 and 2.3 - Point 3 ("The Geographical Area"). The geographical area is divided into two delivery areas, delivery area B which makes up sub-contract 1 and delivery area C, which makes up sub-contract 2. Annex A makes up the total coverage area for sub-contracts 1 and 2. The Contracting Authority will, thus, enter into two total agreements. Tenderers can submit tenders for sub-contracts in both delivery areas, but there must be separate tender offers, cf. point 1.4 in the tender documentation.
